report_name: Ransomware Groups Target Healthcare, Finance, and Government

threat_actors.name: Akira
threat_actors.description: The Akira ransomware group listed Gale Credit Union and Algra Group as victims on its data leak site as part of a widespread campaign using double extortion tactics.

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: The Qilin ransomware group claimed responsibility for attacks on City Ambulance Service and Grayson Rural Electric Cooperative Corporation, compromising sensitive personal and health information.

threat_actors.name: Direwolf
threat_actors.description: The Direwolf ransomware group targeted gaming company THQ Nordic as part of a wave of attacks across multiple sectors.

threat_actors.name: INC_RANSOM
threat_actors.description: The INC_RANSOM group targeted Canadian glass manufacturer Multiver Ltée in a widespread ransomware campaign.

threat_actors.name: Wallstreet
threat_actors.description: The 'Wallstreet' ransomware group claimed to have breached the municipal government of the City of Ormond Beach, Florida.

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Hacker
threat_actors.description: An unnamed hacker claimed to have stolen over 29,600 client records from Blossom Health and demanded a $30,000 ransom.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: Used for initial access by exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities in VPNs or other edge devices.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Used for lateral movement within the compromised network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated large volumes of sensitive data to actor-controlled cloud infrastructure before deploying ransomware.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware payloads were executed across victim networks to encrypt files and render systems unusable as part of a double extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Attackers delete volume shadow copies using vssadmin.exe to prevent system restoration from local backups.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Phishing was mentioned as a common initial access vector for ransomware operations.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Stolen credentials were used as an initial access method in the ransomware attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Brute Force
attack_patterns.description: A high volume of failed logon attempts (Event ID 4625) can indicate brute-force or password spraying attacks used for initial access or privilege escalation.

malware.name: Akira Ransomware
malware.description: The Akira ransomware appends the '.akira' extension to encrypted files. It is used by the Akira threat group in double extortion attacks.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: The Qilin ransomware appends the '.qilin' extension to encrypted files. It was used by the Qilin group to attack City Ambulance Service and Grayson Rural Electric Cooperative Corporation.

malware.name: Direwolf Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by the Direwolf group to target organizations like THQ Nordic.

malware.name: INC Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by the INC_RANSOM group to target organizations like Multiver Ltée.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: Used by attackers for reconnaissance and lateral movement after gaining initial access to a victim's network.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: A legitimate command-line tool for managing cloud storage, often abused by ransomware groups for bulk data exfiltration.

identities.name: Blossom Health
identities.description: A telehealth provider in New York targeted by an unnamed hacker who claimed to have stolen 29,600 client records.

identities.name: Gale Credit Union
identities.description: A financial institution in Illinois listed as a victim by the Akira ransomware group.

identities.name: City of Ormond Beach
identities.description: A municipal government agency in Florida that was claimed as a victim by the 'Wallstreet' ransomware group.

identities.name: City Ambulance Service
identities.description: A healthcare provider in Texas attacked by the Qilin ransomware group, resulting in the compromise of 14,324 residents' data.

identities.name: Grayson Rural Electric Cooperative Corporation
identities.description: An energy cooperative in the USA targeted by the Qilin ransomware group.

identities.name: THQ Nordic
identities.description: A gaming company targeted by the Direwolf ransomware group.

identities.name: Algra Group
identities.description: A Swiss manufacturer targeted by the Akira ransomware group.

identities.name: Multiver Ltée
identities.description: A Canadian glass manufacturer targeted by the INC_RANSOM group.

infrastructure.name: Ransomware Data Exfiltration Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Actor-controlled infrastructure, likely cloud storage, used to exfiltrate large volumes of sensitive data from victims before encryption.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c5b1f3a-8d7e-4b9f-a1d2-c3b4e5f6a7b8
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://sharkstriker.com/blog/september-2026-data-breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-03
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects commands used to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to prevent system recovery.

indicators.name: Rclone Execution for Data Exfiltration
indicators.pattern:
title: Rclone Execution for Data Exfiltration
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool often abused by ransomware groups for bulk data exfiltration to cloud storage.
references:
  - https://sharkstriker.com/blog/september-2026-data-breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-03
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a legitimate tool often abused by ransomware actors for data exfiltration.

indicators.name: Ransomware File Extension Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Extension Creation (Akira, Qilin)
id: b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects file rename events where common ransomware extensions like .akira or .qilin are appended.
references:
  - https://sharkstriker.com/blog/september-2026-data-breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-03
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.akira'
      - '.qilin'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files being renamed with extensions associated with Akira and Qilin ransomware.

indicators.name: High Volume of Failed Logon Attempts
indicators.pattern:
title: High Volume of Failed Logon Attempts
id: c3d4e5f6-a7b8-4c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of failed logon attempts (Windows Event ID 4625), which can indicate brute-force or password spraying attacks.
references:
  - https://sharkstriker.com/blog/september-2026-data-breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-03
tags:
  - attack.t1110
  - attack.credential_access
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4625
  condition: selection | count() > 20 by host
indicators.description: Detects a potential brute-force or password spraying attack by monitoring for a high volume of failed logon events (Event ID 4625).
